report_name: Multiple Data Breaches Disclosed Across US Sectors

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Actors
threat_actors.description: Represents the various unauthorized actors responsible for the data breaches at Modoc Medical Center, Blanchard Training & Development, and Peña and Bromberg, as described in the report.

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Third-Party Vendor Actor
threat_actors.description: Represents the unauthorized actor that compromised a former third-party vendor of L.A. Care Health Plan, resulting in a supply chain attack.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: Unauthorized actors accessed and exfiltrated files containing sensitive PII, PHI, and financial data from the victims' network repositories.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: A data breach at a former third-party vendor of L.A. Care Health Plan led to the potential exposure of member data, representing a supply chain attack.

identities.name: Modoc Medical Center
identities.description: A US-based medical center that suffered a data breach between January 19 and 27, 2026, resulting in the exfiltration of files containing patient PII, PHI, and financial data.

identities.name: Blanchard Training & Development, Inc.
identities.description: A US-based professional services firm that experienced a network intrusion between March 3 and 4, 2026, potentially leading to the theft of personal information for 310 individuals.

identities.name: Peña and Bromberg
identities.description: A US-based law firm that suffered a data breach on May 7, 2026, where an unauthorized party acquired files containing client names and Social Security numbers.

identities.name: L.A. Care Health Plan
identities.description: A US-based health plan whose members' data was potentially exposed due to a breach at a former third-party vendor that occurred between October 2024 and January 2025.

indicators.name: Anomalous Large Data Upload to Cloud Storage
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Large Data Upload to Cloud Storage
id: 2b9c1a8e-7d3f-4e5a-9b1c-8a7d6e5f4d3c
status: experimental
description: Detects large data uploads to common personal cloud storage services, which may indicate data exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.mondaq.com/unitedstates/data-protection/1849732/the-data-breach-brief-week-of-september-30th-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-01
tags:
  - attack.t1213
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_method:
    cs-method: 'POST'
  selection_host:
    cs-host|endswith:
      - '.dropbox.com'
      - '.mega.nz'
      - '.gofile.io'
      - '.mediafire.com'
      - '.onedrive.live.com'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects network traffic patterns indicative of large data uploads to personal cloud storage services, a potential method for data exfiltration.

relationships.source_name: Anomalous Large Data Upload to Cloud Storage
